title: Hrodulf's Madness
description: A non-journal quest investigating the charred ruins of Hrodulf's House on Solstheim, uncovering the tragic fate of Hrodulf and his lover Bjornolfr through letters and a journal, and discovering a hidden Dwemer chamber beneath the house that drove Hrodulf mad.

base_facts: I moved into a house on Solstheim and became obsessed with a strange rumbling from beneath the basement.
I heard a calling from the depths and broke through the wall behind my bookshelf to find the source.
I begged Bjornolfr to stay away from the house for his own safety.

READ_HRODULF_JOURNAL: My journal reveals I grew obsessed with voices from beneath the basement and bought digging tools.
DISCOVER_DWEMER_CHAMBER: I dug a tunnel to a Dwemer chamber with still-functioning machines that likely drove me mad.
FIND_HRODULF: I tried to escape Solstheim by canoe but was killed by a burnt spriggan on the coast south of my house.
My body lies near a canoe on the southern coast, with a burnt spriggan still standing over it.
I realized my madness too late and fled for the canoe, but my obsession had already cost Bjornolfr his life.
Scrap metal—a broken iron war axe head and handle—can be found near my corpse.

base_facts: I am from Solitude and Hrodulf is my lover.
I wrote to Hrodulf begging him to leave Solstheim and return to Solitude.

READ_BJORNOLFR_LETTER: My letter to Hrodulf shows great concern for his welfare and pleads with him to return to Solitude.
DISCOVER_DWEMER_CHAMBER: I traveled to Solstheim to find Hrodulf but was killed by reavers in the tunnel beneath his house.

beats.comment: Player arrives at Hrodulf's House and encounters ash spawn outside the charred shack.
Player goes through the trap door and finds reavers in the basement who were reading Bjornolfr's letter.
Player reads Bjornolfr's letter on the table expressing concern for Hrodulf and urging him to return to Solitude.
Player reads Hrodulf's journal on the crate, learning about his growing madness and obsession with the voices from the depths.
Player pushes aside the bookshelf, finds the tunnel Hrodulf dug, and discovers the Dwemer chamber with Bjornolfr's body and a bloodstained letter.
Player finds Hrodulf's body on the coast south of his house near a canoe, killed by a burnt spriggan after trying to escape Solstheim.
